# New York Metropolitan Area

[All metro areas](../data-sources.md)

**Covers:** New York City, Long Island, the Hudson Valley, northern and central New Jersey, southern Connecticut to New London and Mystic, and Pike County, PA. The title bar shows which of these parts a place is in: New York City, Long Island, Hudson Valley, Northern New Jersey, Central New Jersey, Connecticut or Pike County, PA.

**Counties:** New York County, NY; Kings County, NY; Queens County, NY; Bronx County, NY; Richmond County, NY; Nassau County, NY; Suffolk County, NY; Westchester County, NY; Rockland County, NY; Orange County, NY; Putnam County, NY; Dutchess County, NY; Ulster County, NY; Sullivan County, NY; Bergen County, NJ; Essex County, NJ; Hudson County, NJ; Morris County, NJ; Passaic County, NJ; Sussex County, NJ; Union County, NJ; Middlesex County, NJ; Somerset County, NJ; Monmouth County, NJ; Mercer County, NJ; Ocean County, NJ; Hunterdon County, NJ; Western Connecticut Planning Region, CT; Greater Bridgeport Planning Region, CT; South Central Connecticut Planning Region, CT; Naugatuck Valley Planning Region, CT; Lower Connecticut River Valley Planning Region, CT; Southeastern Connecticut Planning Region, CT; Pike County, PA. Within the service area, the app tells which metro area and which of its parts a place is in by its county (in Connecticut, its planning region), or, on the water or a pier, by the nearest county. [Why these counties](../metro-areas.md#new-york-metropolitan-area)

## Keys and accounts

Most real-time feeds here are free and need no key. For the ones below, you request a key or account yourself. Each is free, each person uses their own, and the app keeps it only in the macOS Keychain. Without it, that operator's times come from its timetable and are marked "Timetable", except where noted below.

- **MTA Bus Time key** (MTA bus real-time data): open the [MTA Bus Time sign-up page](https://register.developer.obanyc.com/), enter your name and email, and MTA emails you the key. Paste it in **Settings → Data source → Keys and accounts**. MTA bus times are live only, so without the key no MTA bus times are shown.
- **NJ Transit developer account** (NJ Transit rail and bus real-time data): sign up on the [NJ Transit developer site](https://developer.njtransit.com/registration) and select the GTFS-RAIL and GTFS-BUS APIs. NJ Transit reviews each request and emails you when the account is approved. Enter the same username and password in **Settings → Data source → Keys and accounts**, with the username written exactly as the developer site shows it at the top right and the approval email writes it, including capital letters.
- **Swiftly key** (Suffolk County Transit real-time data): fill in the [Swiftly request form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScy9Jye91QPSTS3WVEU-13es0A1rT9Ep5JhAmXUZEiop7fmIw/viewform) linked from Suffolk County's website, choosing Suffolk County Transit and GTFS-Realtime Trip Updates. Swiftly reviews each request and emails you the key. Paste it in **Settings → Data source → Keys and accounts**.

## Stations without times

These operators don't publish their times in a form the app can use, so nothing is downloaded from them. The app lists their stations and piers without departures, with an **Open Website** button for the operator's own page.
